data.name: Furhud
data.gender_notes: Furhud is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Furhud means 'protector' or 'guardian'. This name is derived from the Arabic verb 'farhada' which means 'to protect'. It is a name with deep spiritual significance and is often given to boys in Muslim communities as a symbol of protection and guidance. The name Furhud carries the meaning “Protector, Guardian” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Furhud usually hope their child will grow to embody protector, guardian and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of protection and guidance.
data.etymology: Furhud belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector, Guardian.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Furhud total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: فرهود
in_arabic.long_meaning: فرهود هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و يعني الشخص الذي يتميز بالحميدة والفروض العالية، وهو مشتق من الفرهودية التي تعبر عن الارتفاع والعلو في الأخلاق والصفات الحميدة. ورد ذكره في بعض المصادر العربية القديمة كاسم للشخصيات الرفيعة المستوى

in_urdu.name: فرهود
in_urdu.meaning: فرهود ۔ ایک خوبصورت اور معنی خیز نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: اردو میں فرهود کا مطلب ہے ایک ایسا شخص جو عظیم اور بلند کردار کا حامل ہو۔ یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے جہاں اس کا مطلب ہے 'خوبصورت کردار والا' یا 'اچھی صفات کا مالک'۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں اس کا استعمال ایک عظیم الشان نام کے طور پر کیا جاتا ہے

in_hindi.name: फरहुद
in_hindi.meaning: फरहुद एक सुंदर और अर्थपूर्ण नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: फरहुद का अर्थ है एक ऐसा व्यक्ति जो महान और उच्च चरित्र का धारक हो। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है जहां इसका अर्थ है 'सुंदर चरित्र वाला' या 'अच्छे गुणों का मालिक'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका उपयोग एक महान नाम के रूप में किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: فرهوده
in_pashto.meaning: فرهوده د يو ښه او معنوي نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: په پښتو کې فرهوده د هغې سړي لپاره کارول کیږي کوم چې لوی او ښه اخلاق لري. دا نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی چیرته چې د معنی 'ښې سلوکې' یا 'د ښه ځانګړتیاو لرونکی'. په افغان او پښتني دود کې دا د یو ویاړلي نوم په توګه کارول کیږي

Additionally, Furhud can be seen as a reflection of the concept of Allah as the ultimate protector and guardian of all believers.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Furhud holds great significance as it symbolizes the idea of being protected and guided by a higher power. It serves as a reminder that Allah is the ultimate guardian and protector of all believers, and that they should trust in His guidance and protection. The name Furhud can also be seen as a call to be a guardian and protector of others, embodying the virtues of compassion, kindness, and selflessness. Overall, the name Furhud is a powerful reminder of the interconnectedness of all beings and the importance of protection and guidance in both the physical and spiritual realms.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Kathir, Al-Bidaiwya, vol. 11, p. 451. Al-Khawarizmi mentions Al-Furhud as the name of a leading Companion in the Battle of Hunayn, where Muhammad led a large army to confront the tribes of Hawazin and Tha'laba.

Ibn Sa'd, Al-Tabaqat Al-Kubra, vol. 3, p. 61. Al-Furhud is mentioned as the name of a Companion who took part in the military expedition led by Khalid ibn Al-Walid against the tribes of Banu Huyayya and Banu Asad.
